decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - No development of any individual phase of the project shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the relevant phase of the hereby permitted development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The five phases for development are as follows (1) Ealing Road Stand and Canopy Roof (2) Ealing Road South East Corner toilets/office or store/kiosk (3) Ealing Road North East Corner toilets/alcoves for kiosks (4) New Road North Stand external surfaces and construction - ground floor toilets and alcoves for kiosks (sub divided East, Central and West) (5) New Road North Stand Construction - first floor viewing area (sub divided East, Central and West)
